turns.learner: Hello! Can you give me an exercise on word order (subject + verb + object)?
turns.tutor:
The rule: put the doer first, then the action, then the thing; place or time goes at the end.
Right: "The farmer feeds the cows." Wrong: "Feeds the farmer the cows." The wrong one starts with the verb, so the doer is not first.
Worked example with "eats / a banana / the monkey": first, I find the doer: the monkey. Then the action: eats. Then the thing: a banana. So: "The monkey eats a banana."
Now use the same steps. Put in order: "plays / Sam / chess / on Mondays"
